[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[File:Tearsofthefallenvq.png|200px]] | pic2-text = Vanquish path | ingame name=Tears of the Fallen | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=053 }} [[Tears of the Fallen]] is a small, [[Bog Skale]]-infested area in [[Kryta]]. The area likely gets its name from the two tear-shaped pools that are found just a short distance from the beach. Small hillside farms can be found on the west side of the lakes. ==Getting there== Travel north from [[Fishermen's Haven]] or [[Sanctum Cay (outpost)|Sanctum Cay]] through [[Stingray Strand]], or from [[Riverside Province (outpost)|Riverside Province]] through [[Twin Serpent Lakes]]. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s: *South, at the exit into [[Stingray Strand]]. *Northeast, at the exit into [[Talmark Wilderness]]. ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Arris Weston]] ([[collector]] for 4 [[Spiked Crest]]s) *{{x}} 10 (20) [[Daved Logsdon]] (collector for 4 [[Abnormal Seed]]s) ===Foes=== [[Drake]]s *{{e}} 20 (26) [[Grand Drake]] *{{e}} 18 (25) [[Lightning Drake]] [[Skale]]s *{{n}} 17 (24) [[Bog Skale Blighter]] *{{n}} 18 (25) [[Bog Skale Icetooth]] ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 0.3% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 64|low = 64|high = 72|notes= A group of [[Bog Skale Icetooth]]s may be difficult to spot in the southwestern corner, across a gap from [[Arris Weston]]. }} ==Trivia== *This is one of the few areas in [[Kryta]] that has no changes during the [[War in Kryta]] storyline. *According to a list on Guild Wars Guru, which seems to list various beta locations, this zone was previously called ''Giant Falls''.[https://web.archive.org/web/20050222021146/www.guildwarsguru.com/kryta-id14.php List of Kryta locations], Guild Wars Guru (archived) {{Explorable areas in Kryta}} [[de:Tränen der Gefallenen]]
